'''Kor Besadii''' was a [[Swamp/Legends|swampy]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Located in the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region, it served as the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Besadii maintained vast palaces and opulent estates in the planet's swamps,<ref name="TEA" /> and the structures were maintained by [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] beings who frequently mounted escape attempts and even revolts.

==Description==
Kor Besadii was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LoNH" /> located in the [[Kor Besadii system/Legends|Kor Besadii system]], a part of the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' area in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. It was connected by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Kor Hestilic system/Legends|Kor Hestilic system]].<ref name="TEA" /> Kor Besadii's surface featured vast, lush [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]]<ref name="LoNH" /> and was considered a representative [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Kor Besadii served as the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which was among the first of the Hutt clans to establish a throneworld of their own. Unlike other throneworlds, or even the species' adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], Kor Besadii's surface conditions meant there was little need for [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] it to suit the Hutt tastes,<ref name="LoNH" /> and the planet became representative of the Hutt throneworlds.<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
The Besadii were among the first Hutts to store on their throneworld riches from both Hutt Space and beyond. The clan used large numbers of [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] beings to maintain their palaces, and&mdash;unbeknownst to even a majority of the Hutts, let alone the wider [[galactic community]]&mdash;the harsh conditions of the workers regularly led to escape attempts and occasionally even gave rise to revolts. Few of the enslaved beings managed to escape Kor Besadii alive, however.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Locations==
The Besadii owned ancient, expansive palaces and opulent estates in Kor Besadii's swamps&mdash;including [[Gercor's Retreat]], which spread across a hundred islands in the middle of a large swamp.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kor Besadii was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-10.<ref name="TEA" />
